<description>
Closes #27583.

`PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB` already serializes, deserializes and merges when PSBTs are combined. Nothing writes it, so a PSBT produced by the wallet never carries it, and a signer that only has the file cannot rebuild the multisig from it. Today Specter [fills the field itself](https://github.com/cryptoadvance/specter-desktop/blob/8843e2f0640a9adc129f9ab6afe5ecb9632e7c5b/src/cryptoadvance/specter/wallet/wallet.py#L1866-L1881) after getting the PSBT from Core.

Before and after with the BitBox02 and Trezor simulators

A 2-of-3 `wsh(sortedmulti(...))` on regtest with the simulator as one co-signer, signed through HWI 3.2.0. The "before" file is the same PSBT with its `PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB` records removed, so nothing else differs.

| | without the field | with the field |
|---|---|---|
| BitBox02 | refuses, `This BitBox02 is not one of the cosigners` | signs |
| Trezor T | signs, co-signer nodes sent with zeroed chain codes and no derivation paths | signs, nodes sent with the real chain codes and paths |

What `parse_multisig` hands the Trezor for the change output:

```
without: global xpubs=0  zeroed chain codes=3/3  depths=[0, 0, 0]  paths=[[], [], []]
with   : global xpubs=3  zeroed chain codes=0/3  depths=[4, 4, 4]  paths=[[1, 0], [1, 0], [1, 0]]
```

A new `Descriptor` accessor returns the extended keys a descriptor is built from, and `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::FillPSBT` writes those of every descriptor with an input or an output in the PSBT. That covers `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `walletprocesspsbt`, `send`, `sendall`, `psbtbumpfee` and the GUI send dialog, which all go through `CWallet::FillPSBT`.

Only the keys BIP 174 allows are added, the ones that derive, through unhardened steps alone, a key their descriptor produced, listed in the PSBT at the origin the descriptor gave it. So a key expression ending in `/*h` adds nothing.

Whoever holds a PSBT from the wallet can now derive the addresses of the descriptors it uses. Setting `bip32derivs` to false in `walletcreatefundedpsbt` or `walletprocesspsbt` leaves the field out, along with the derivation paths.

`descriptorprocesspsbt` is left out, since it signs from the descriptors it is given without going through the wallet, and I intend to cover it as a follow-up.
</description>

<commits>
31b2f8cb00 descriptor: add GetExtPubKeysWithOrigins

Give Descriptor a way to hand out the extended public keys it is built
from, each keyed by its origin.

Each BIP 32 key expression gives the key at its last hardened step when
the descriptor cache holds that key, and its root key otherwise. The key
at the last hardened step is the one the expression's unhardened
children derive from. A key origin written in the descriptor takes the
place of the root's fingerprint and is prepended to the path. A musig()
expression hands out its participants' keys, and a plain public key has
none to give.

The keys carry the network's version bytes, since BIP 174 serializes
those bytes as part of each PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB key and a key parsed from a
descriptor lacks them. The wallet starts using this in the next commit.

118c6d1f73 wallet: fill PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB

BIP 174 lets a PSBT carry the extended public keys that the keys in its
inputs and outputs derive from, so that a signer holding no wallet
state can rebuild the scripts from the PSBT alone. The PSBT code
already serializes, deserializes and merges PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB, but the
wallet never writes it.

Have DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::FillPSBT add the extended keys of every
descriptor that contributed an input or an output, unless bip32derivs
is false. That covers walletcreatefundedpsbt, walletprocesspsbt, send,
sendall, psbtbumpfee and the GUI, which all go through
CWallet::FillPSBT.

Only keys that BIP 174 allows go in. A key has to derive, through
unhardened steps alone, one of the keys the descriptor produced that the
PSBT gives a derivation path for, and its path has to have as many steps
as its depth. The derivation is checked by deriving the key and
comparing it with the listed one, since keys can share an origin. The
first rule leaves out the root key a descriptor falls back to when its
cache lacks the key at the last hardened step, which is always the case
with /*h derivation. The second leaves out a non-master key written in
the descriptor without its origin.

A path in a PSBT is only what its sender claims, so a listed key counts
only at the origin the descriptor gave it, and nothing is derived along
any other path, however many the PSBT lists.

A key the PSBT already carries keeps the origin it has there, since
BIP 174 allows one record per key. MergeGlobalXPubs already does this
when PSBTs are combined, and now takes the xpubs to merge rather than
a whole PSBT, so that the wallet adds its own through it.

A PSBT from the wallet now carries the extended keys of the
descriptors it uses, and whoever holds it can derive their addresses.
Setting bip32derivs to false in walletcreatefundedpsbt or
walletprocesspsbt leaves them out, along with the derivation paths.

The BIP 174 updater test vector now carries the extended keys of its
descriptors.
</commits>

+//! Whether this key, at this origin, derives one of the listed keys through unhardened steps
+//! alone. A listed key comes with the origin the descriptor gave it, but keys can share an
+//! origin, so the child is derived and compared with the listed key.
+static bool DerivesKeyInPSBT(const KeyOriginInfo& origin, const CExtPubKey& key, const std::map<CPubKey, KeyOriginInfo>& listed)
+{
+    return std::ranges::any_of(listed, [&](const auto& entry) {
+        const auto& [pubkey, info]{entry};
+        if (info.fingerprint != origin.fingerprint || info.path.size() < origin.path.size()) return false;
+        const auto rest{info.path.begin() + origin.path.size()};
+        // Every step is checked before any is derived, since deriving a hardened step from a
+        // public key asserts.
+        if (!std::equal(info.path.begin(), rest, origin.path.begin()) ||
+            std::any_of(rest, info.path.end(), [](uint32_t step) { return (step & BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG) != 0; })) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        CExtPubKey child{key};
+        for (auto step{rest}; step != info.path.end(); ++step) {
+            if (!child.Derive(child, *step)) return false;
+        }
+        return child.pubkey == pubkey;
+    });
+}

+void DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::AddGlobalXpubs(PartiallySignedTransaction& psbtx) const
+{
+    LOCK(cs_desc_man);
+
+    // The keys the PSBT lists that this descriptor produced, at the origin it gave them. A path
+    // in a PSBT is only what its sender claims, so any other key or path is dropped here, and
+    // nothing is derived along a path the descriptor did not give. The work below is bounded by
+    // the descriptor's own keys whatever the PSBT lists.
+    std::map<CPubKey, KeyOriginInfo> listed;
+    std::map<int32_t, std::unique_ptr<FlatSigningProvider>> providers;
+    const auto take{[&](const CPubKey& pubkey, const KeyOriginInfo& claimed) EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(cs_desc_man) {
+        const auto found{m_map_pubkeys.find(pubkey)};
+        if (found == m_map_pubkeys.end()) return;
+        const auto [cached, first]{providers.try_emplace(found->second)};
+        if (first) cached->second = GetSigningProvider(found->second, /*include_private=*/false);
+        const FlatSigningProvider* provider{cached->second.get()};
+        KeyOriginInfo info;
+        if (provider && provider->GetKeyOrigin(pubkey.GetID(), info) && info == claimed) listed.emplace(pubkey, std::move(info));
+    }};
+    const auto take_all{[&](const auto& in_or_out) EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED(cs_desc_man) {
+        for (const auto& [pubkey, claimed] : in_or_out.hd_keypaths) {
+            take(pubkey, claimed);
+        }
+        for (const auto& [xonly, leaves_and_origin] : in_or_out.m_tap_bip32_paths) {
+            for (const CPubKey& pubkey : xonly.GetCPubKeys()) {
+                take(pubkey, leaves_and_origin.second);
+            }
+        }
+    }};
+    for (const PSBTInput& input : psbtx.inputs) {
+        take_all(input);
+    }
+    for (const PSBTOutput& output : psbtx.outputs) {
+        take_all(output);
+    }
+
+    std::map<KeyOriginInfo, std::set<CExtPubKey>> xpubs{
+        m_wallet_descriptor.descriptor->GetExtPubKeysWithOrigins(&m_wallet_descriptor.cache)};
+
+    // BIP 174 wants the keys that the transaction's keys derive from, each with as many
+    // steps in its path as its depth. Where the cache lacks the key at the last hardened
+    // step, the descriptor hands out its root instead, and a root with hardened steps still
+    // below it derives none of them; a key written without its origin has a path too short
+    // for its depth. Neither can go in. Keys that share an origin are judged one by one,
+    // since they need not share an answer.
+    for (auto& [origin, keys] : xpubs) {
+        std::erase_if(keys, [&](const CExtPubKey& key) {
+            return origin.path.size() != size_t{key.nDepth} || !DerivesKeyInPSBT(origin, key, listed);
+        });
+    }
+
+    // A key the PSBT already carries, from another descriptor, from this one or from whoever
+    // sent it, keeps the origin it has there, since BIP 174 allows one record per key.
+    psbtx.MergeGlobalXPubs(xpubs);
+}

+/** The extended public keys a descriptor contributes, keyed by the origin they carry,
+ *  in the string form a descriptor writes them in. */
+std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> ExtPubKeysWithOrigins(const std::string& desc_str, const DescriptorCache* cache = nullptr)
+{
+    FlatSigningProvider keys;
+    std::string error;
+    const auto descs = Parse(desc_str, keys, error, /*require_checksum=*/false);
+    BOOST_REQUIRE_MESSAGE(descs.size() == 1, error);
+
+    const std::map<KeyOriginInfo, std::set<CExtPubKey>> xpubs{descs.at(0)->GetExtPubKeysWithOrigins(cache)};
+
+    const auto& version{Params().Base58Prefix(CChainParams::EXT_PUBLIC_KEY)};
+    std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> ret;
+    for (const auto& [origin, keyset] : xpubs) {
+        for (const CExtPubKey& xpub : keyset) {
+            // A PSBT serializes these keys with their own version bytes, unlike a
+            // descriptor, so every key handed out has to carry them.
+            BOOST_CHECK(std::equal(version.begin(), version.end(), std::begin(xpub.version)));
+            ret.emplace(HexStr(origin.fingerprint) + FormatHDKeypath(origin.path), EncodeExtPubKey(xpub));
+        }
+    }
+    return ret;
+}
+
+void CheckExtPubKeys(const std::string& desc_str, const std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>& expected, const DescriptorCache* cache = nullptr)
+{
+    BOOST_CHECK_MESSAGE(ExtPubKeysWithOrigins(desc_str, cache) == expected, desc_str);
+}
+
+//! The fingerprint of an extended key, computed without going through a descriptor.
+std::string Fingerprint(const std::string& ext_key)
+{
+    const CExtKey xprv{DecodeExtKey(ext_key)};
+    const CExtPubKey xpub{xprv.key.IsValid() ? xprv.Neuter() : DecodeExtPubKey(ext_key)};
+    return HexStr(xpub.pubkey.GetID().fingerprint());
+}
+
+//! The extended public key at a path, derived without going through a descriptor.
+std::string DeriveExtPubKey(const std::string& xprv_str, const std::vector<uint32_t>& path)
+{
+    CExtKey key{DecodeExtKey(xprv_str)};
+    BOOST_REQUIRE(key.key.IsValid());
+    for (const uint32_t step : path) {
+        CExtKey child;
+        BOOST_REQUIRE(key.Derive(child, step));
+        key = child;
+    }
+    return EncodeExtPubKey(key.Neuter());
+}
+
+BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(descriptor_extpubkeys_with_origins)
+{
+    const std::string XPRV{"xprvA1RpRA33e1JQ7ifknakTFpgNXPmW2YvmhqLQYMmrj4xJXXWYpDPS3xz7iAxn8L39njGVyuoseXzU6rcxFLJ8HFsTjSyQbLYnMpCqE2VbFWc"};
+    const std::string XPUB{"xpub6ERApfZwUNrhLCkDtcHTcxd75RbzS1ed54G1LkBUHQVHQKqhMkhgbmJbZRkrgZw4koxb5JaHWkY4ALHY2grBGRjaDMzQLcgJvLJuZZvRcEL"};
+    const std::string XPUB2{"xpub68NZiKmJWnxxS6aaHmn81bvJeTESw724CRDs6HbuccFQN9Ku14VQrADWgqbhhTHBaohPX4CjNLf9fq9MYo6oDaPPLPxSb7gwQN3ih19Zm4Y"};
+    const std::string FP{Fingerprint(XPUB)};
+    const std::string FP2{Fingerprint(XPUB2)};
+
+    // With no hardened step, the key written in the descriptor is the one the children
+    // are derived from, and it is published with an empty path.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPUB + "/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}});
+    // The private form of the same descriptor publishes the same key.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPRV + "/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}});
+
+    // The key at the last hardened step is only reachable through the cache, since
+    // deriving it needs the private key. Without one, the root is what is left, whether
+    // the descriptor carries the private key or not.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPRV + "/84h/0h/0h/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}});
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPUB + "/84h/0h/0h/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}});
+
+    // With the key in the cache, that key is published, and the origin is the path down
+    // to it.
+    const std::string lh_xpub{DeriveExtPubKey(XPRV, {84 | BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG, BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG, BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG})};
+    DescriptorCache cache;
+    cache.CacheLastHardenedExtPubKey(0, DecodeExtPubKey(lh_xpub));
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPUB + "/84h/0h/0h/0/*)", {{FP + "/84h/0h/0h", lh_xpub}}, &cache);
+
+    // A key origin in the descriptor is what the published origin starts from.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh([00aabb22/48h]" + XPUB + "/0/*)", {{"00aabb22/48h", XPUB}});
+    // And it is prepended to whatever the key expression contributes, including the path
+    // down to a key from the cache.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh([00aabb22/48h]" + XPRV + "/0h/0/*)", {{"00aabb22/48h", XPUB}});
+    const std::string lh_after_origin{DeriveExtPubKey(XPRV, {BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG})};
+    DescriptorCache origin_cache;
+    origin_cache.CacheLastHardenedExtPubKey(0, DecodeExtPubKey(lh_after_origin));
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh([00aabb22/48h]" + XPUB + "/0h/0/*)", {{"00aabb22/48h/0h", lh_after_origin}}, &origin_cache);
+
+    // A cached key whose depth does not fit the path cannot be the key at the last
+    // hardened step, so the root is what is left.
+    DescriptorCache shallower_cache;
+    shallower_cache.CacheLastHardenedExtPubKey(0, DecodeExtPubKey(XPUB2));
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPUB + "/84h/0h/0h/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}}, &shallower_cache);
+    DescriptorCache deeper_cache;
+    deeper_cache.CacheLastHardenedExtPubKey(0, DecodeExtPubKey(DeriveExtPubKey(XPRV, {BIP32_HARDENED_FLAG, 0})));
+    CheckExtPubKeys("pkh(" + XPUB + "/0h)", {{FP, XPUB}}, &deeper_cache);
+
+    // Every key expression contributes, including through a subdescriptor.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wsh(multi(2," + XPUB + "/0/*," + XPUB2 + "/0/*))", {{FP, XPUB}, {FP2, XPUB2}});
+    CheckExtPubKeys("sh(wsh(multi(2," + XPUB + "/0/*," + XPUB2 + "/0/*)))", {{FP, XPUB}, {FP2, XPUB2}});
+
+    // A hardened ranged expression has no key its children derive from either, so the
+    // root is what it offers.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(" + XPRV + "/0h/*h)", {{FP, XPUB}});
+    // A plain public key has no extended key behind it.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("wpkh(03a34b99f22c790c4e36b2b3c2c35a36db06226e41c692fc82b8b56ac1c540c5bd)", {});
+    // MuSig hands out its participants' keys, whether the derivation comes before the
+    // aggregation or after it, and a participant with no extended key adds nothing.
+    CheckExtPubKeys("rawtr(musig(" + XPUB + "," + XPUB2 + ")/0/*)", {{FP, XPUB}, {FP2, XPUB2}});
+    CheckExtPubKeys("rawtr(musig(" + XPUB + "/0/*," + XPUB2 + "/0/*))", {{FP, XPUB}, {FP2, XPUB2}});
+    CheckExtPubKeys("rawtr(musig(" + XPUB + "/0/*,03a34b99f22c790c4e36b2b3c2c35a36db06226e41c692fc82b8b56ac1c540c5bd))", {{FP, XPUB}});
+}
